acceptanceCriteria: A new Work Item with an unsupported required evidence class is rejected or marked blocked before verification starts, with the supported forms listed.
A Contract declaring verification and delegated:github requires both evidence classes; one missing class remains incomplete.
Existing historical Contracts remain readable and are not rewritten by the new validation.
The CLI and documentation expose the same evidence-class vocabulary and recovery action.
goal: Make required-evidence authoring fail early with an actionable diagnostic, evaluate all declared classes without short-circuiting, and preserve compatibility for historical Contracts.
intent: Prevent invalid lifecycle evidence declarations from reaching expensive verification and require every declared supported evidence class to be evaluated.
outOfScope: new evidence providers or external authority semantics

scenarioCoverage.expected: start rejects an unknown class and names the supported forms
scenarioCoverage.scenario: unsupported required evidence class is rejected before verification
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the lifecycle regression and inspect the CLI diagnostic.

scenarioCoverage.expected: verification plus delegated:github remains incomplete when either declared class is missing
scenarioCoverage.scenario: all declared evidence classes are evaluated
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run repository evidence-state regressions with each class missing and then both satisfied.

scenarioCoverage.expected: a legacy Contract containing an old lifecycle label remains readable and its bytes are not rewritten
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the archived Contract read-only gate and compare bytes before and after.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect command help and documentation tests.
